units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 5:1">Tosef. Keth. V, 1</cite> <he>הב׳ כתביעה</he> (read <he>בת׳</he>, Var. ed. Zuck. <he>הבּוֹגֶרֶת בתביעה</he>) she who is of age when asked (by her betrothed) to be married; Y. ib. 29ᵈ <he>הב׳ בשעה</he> (corr. acc.). Ib. <he>נותנין לב׳ וכ׳</he> a girl of age is allowed twelve months for preparation for her wedding.—Ch. v. <cite ref="B00082"><he>בַּגִּיר</he></cite>.
